reason_autonomous_resolution_not_possibl: Category 4 (Authorization: an action on infrastructure outside the experimental sandbox). The operator instructed on 2026-11-18 to bring the integration branch into V3-013 so that the codex-worker review service's ancestry check passes. The merge was prepared with git plumbing in the shared object store: merge tree fc23e3aa (git merge-tree, no conflicts; exactly the eleven infrastructure, infrastructure-test and SETUP.md files of PR #93), merge commit 795de2a1 (parents 2d9e90e1 and 8ca9d4fc, the fixed autonomous identity). Advancing the branch reference requires locking the worktree's HEAD file, which lives in the read-only per-worktree git directory; no MCP tool performs a merge or ref update (commit_task_changes commits the working tree only, which cannot create the required ancestry). A rebase or a fresh worktree would change every exact-SHA record of V3-013, contrary to "preserve existing work". The working tree is clean at 2d9e90e1.
